breakReminder.message: Checkpoint: if you've finished something, commit + push it now (two-laptop CHECKPOINT ritual) - don't save it all for end of day.

hooks.command: git fetch --all --prune 2>&1; echo ---; git pull --ff-only 2>&1; echo ---; git status 2>&1

dirty=$(git status --porcelain); ahead=$(git rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ -n "$dirty" ] || [ "$ahead" -gt 0 ]; then msg="Uncommitted or unpushed work here - commit + push before leaving this laptop (LEAVE ritual: docs/process/TWO-LAPTOP-WORKFLOW.md)."; printf '{"systemMessage": "%s"}' "$msg"; fi
